title: 第11章 捏石成粉第12章 大力丸
content_zh:
三岔子镇上，李半仙坐在算卦的小摊后面，眼睛打量着来往行人。
做他这一行，就要善于观察，揣摩人心，从各种细节中收集信息，主动发现潜在客户，然后再引客户上钩。
有时候抓住一条肥羊，就能吃上好几年，甚至获益终生。
只是三岔子镇还是太穷了，大部分人恨不得把一个铜板劈成两半花。
逮住一只蚊子，都想着从蚊子腿上剐点精肉下来。
想要赚他们的钱实在太难了。
以至于这么多年以来，李半仙仍然是饥一顿饱一顿。
不知道底细的都说他相貌清瘦，有仙风道骨，其实他做梦都想顿顿大肥肉，吃得脑满肠肥。
直到今年终于时来运转，遇到不通世事的一个傻小子，不但吃上了饱饭，还有肉有酒。
就在他物色路人的时候，就看到街道尽头走来一名少年，身穿一件粗麻布衣服，脚踏草鞋，手上还拎着一块肥膘肉。
肥羊来了，李半仙立即整理一下衣袍，坐直了身子，目不斜视，颇有几分仙风道骨的样子。
心中却已经转了好几十道弯，在琢磨着，今天该怎么忽悠这个便宜徒弟。
那套所谓的绝世武学，他自己曾经练过很久，什么鸟用都没有，纯粹是骗人的玩意。
反正自己教过了，练不成绝世武学，那也是他不够用功，或者是资质太笨，可怨不得这个当师父的。
“师父！”
二狗子大老远地就开始打招呼，李半仙很矜持地捋了一下胡子。
“嗯！你来了！”
“最近修炼可有进展？”
李半仙还记得，二狗子上次向自己请教，似乎遇到什么难题来着，自己忽悠了半天才哄回去的。
心中琢磨着，今天还得加大忽悠力度才行。

“嗯，有进展，我终于修炼入门了！”
二狗子用力点了点头，他对目前的修炼进展很满意。
当然，除了自己的努力之外，还要感谢师父的教导。
所以他这次才舍得下花大价钱，又给师父买了一块上好的肥膘肉。
“修炼入门？”
李半仙是不怎么信的，估计是少年人爱面子，好大喜功，把没有的事说成有，有丁点的事就吹上天。
这门功法他又不是没炼过，一点用都没有。
看来得敲打一下才行，心中琢磨着，随手从地上捡起一块石头，放到桌案上。
“你现在拿起这块石头，捏成粉末给为师看看？”
二狗子连忙摇头，他现在虽然力气很大，但要想捏碎石头，还是不可能的。
“连这么简单的事都做不到，也敢妄言修炼入门！”
李半仙摇了摇头，一副怒其不争的神态，似乎对二狗子有些失望。
只见他把这块小石头随手扔掉，又捡起一块更大的石头，单手用力，石头被捏得粉碎。
李半仙看到二狗子脸上露出惊愕与崇拜的表情，心中甚为满意。
随手将手上的石粉拍掉，面不改色，神色淡然，仿佛做了一件微不足道的小事。
“习武之人要戒骄戒躁，切不可狂妄自大，谨记人外有人，天外有天……”
“师父，我错了！”
被李半仙一顿劈头盖脸的教导，二狗子羞愧难当，一张酱油色的脸瞬间红到了耳根。
content_en:
In Sanchazi Town, Li Banxian sat behind a fortune-telling stall and looked at the passers-by.
In his line of work, one must be good at observation, figure out people's hearts, collect information from various details, proactively discover potential customers, and then lure customers to take the bait.
Sometimes if you catch a fat sheep, you can feed it for several years, or even benefit for a lifetime.
It's just that Sanchazi Town is still too poor, and most people would like to split a copper plate in half.
When I catch a mosquito, I want to cut off some of the sperm from its leg.
It's really hard to make money from them.
So much so that after all these years, Li Banxian was still hungry and full.
People who don't know the details say that he has a thin appearance and an immortal spirit. In fact, he dreams of eating a lot of fat and eating until he is full of fat.
Until this year, things finally turned around. I met a silly boy who didn't understand the world. Not only did he have a full meal, but he also got meat and wine.
Just when he was looking for passers-by, he saw a young man walking at the end of the street, wearing a burlap suit, straw sandals, and carrying a piece of fat in his hand.
When the fat sheep arrived, Li Banxian immediately straightened his robes, sat up straight, and looked straight away, quite like a fairy.
But his mind has already turned dozens of times, thinking about how to fool this cheap apprentice today.
He had practiced the so-called peerless martial arts for a long time, but it was of no use. It was purely a lie.
Anyway, he has taught him, but if he can't practice peerless martial arts, it's because he doesn't work hard enough, or his qualifications are too stupid, but he can't blame this master.
"Master!"
Ergouzi started to say hello from afar, and Li Banxian stroked his beard very reservedly.
"Well! You're here!"
"Has there been any progress in your practice recently?"
Li Banxian still remembered that the last time Ergouzi asked him for advice, he seemed to have encountered some problem, and he deceived him for a long time before coaxing him back.
I was thinking in my mind that I would have to step up my efforts to deceive today.
"Well, there's progress, I've finally started practicing!"
Ergouzi nodded vigorously. He was very satisfied with the current progress of his training.
Of course, in addition to my own efforts, I also want to thank Master for his teachings.
That's why he was willing to spend a lot of money this time and bought another piece of good fat meat for his master.
"Introduction to practice?"
Li Banxian didn't really believe it. It was probably because the young man was so proud of his reputation and was so happy about his success that he made things seem like they didn't exist, and even boasted about the slightest thing.
It's not like he hasn't practiced this technique before, it's useless at all.
It seems that it needs to be hammered. I thought about it, picked up a stone from the ground, and put it on the table.
"Now pick up this stone, crush it into powder and show it to me?"
Ergouzi shook his head quickly. Although he was very strong now, it was still impossible to crush the stone.
"You can't even do such a simple thing, yet you dare to talk about getting started with cultivation!"
Li Banxian shook his head, with an angry look on his face, as if he was a little disappointed with Er Gouzi.
I saw him throwing away the small stone and picking up a bigger stone. With one hand, the stone was crushed into pieces.
Li Banxian was very satisfied when he saw the expression of astonishment and admiration on Er Gouzi's face.
He patted the stone powder off his hand without changing his expression, as if he had done an insignificant thing.
"People who practice martial arts must guard against arrogance and impetuosity, and must not be arrogant. Remember that there are people outside the world, and there is a sky outside the sky..."
"Master, I was wrong!"
Ergouzi was so embarrassed by Li Banxian's harsh instruction that his soy sauce-colored face instantly turned red to his ears.
